title: How Keeping One Small Promise a Day Makes a Godly Man Someone You Can Trust
caption:
You don't become a man people can trust in one big moment. You become him one kept promise at a time.

Pick one small thing for tomorrow. Write it down tonight. Keep it when you don't feel like it, and be honest on the days you miss.

Save this and tell us your one promise for tomorrow.

#faith #godlyman #discipline #integrity
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
